en: A black-and-white image depicting several large, ornate houses with steeply pitched roofs and decorative woodwork, characteristic of late 19th or early 20th-century Central European architecture. The houses are situated atop a stone terrace above a small river with a manmade weir or water gate, and are surrounded by leafless trees, suggesting early spring or late autumn. There is a wooden fence and some gardening structures along the riverbank.
